suggestedResearchArchitecture.structural: Slow BTC original-as-of trend and previous cycle phase, no future label.
suggestedResearchArchitecture.macro: Real yield, broad USD, Fed flow, NFCI/ANFCI (Chicago indexes one correlated family), real rates and credit stress, same date PIT.
suggestedResearchArchitecture.crypto: Exchange/DeFi leverage, onchain flows, custody stablecoins and credit contagion with as-of records.
suggestedResearchArchitecture.shock: Global macro/geopolitical shocks: dated primary announcement, scheduled vs surprise, restrictive vs supportive vs mixed, dates of escalation/de-escalation and market stress transmission.
suggestedResearchArchitecture.interaction: Favorable Fed/NFCI with adverse war/tariff/crypto insolvency headline = CONFLICT event; freeze descriptive state but do NOT automatically sell. Adverse macro with supportive emergency Fed = crisis-response conflict, not guaranteed bounce.
suggestedResearchArchitecture.response: Measure btc return from source as-of announcement to 1h/4h/24h/7d/30d, risk over full path and 26w duration. 24/7 BTC vs weekday stock/Treasury quotes should be time-zone adjusted.
suggestedResearchArchitecture.uncertainty: Unknown event market surprise, official publication time, event degree, stock holiday means incomplete => UNKNOWN, not 0.

futureValidation.initialCorpus: Official timestamped economic releases (FOMC decisions, CPI, payrolls, trade executive orders USTR, WHO emergencies, UN escalation statements); also large DID-NOT-MOVE announcements, matched no-event windows.
futureValidation.classLabels: Announcement vs implementation vs reversal; first public date vs realized later consequences; COVID market turmoil onset prior to formal pandemic declaration; military escalation vs de-escalation; mixed April9 2025
futureValidation.macroSurprise: Where pre-announcement analyst consensus available and archived, calculate release surprise using predicted vs actual; otherwise event surprise UNKNOWN.
futureValidation.riskConfluence: Negative news plus already worsening BTC structure, dollar/rates tightening, widening credit stress or crypto leverage = hypothesis for crash hazard; positive headline alone does not guarantee gains.
futureValidation.controls: Pre-registered baseline prices 2011-2026 daily and hourly when official source proof; same-year and same BTC volatility/price-regime controls, overlapping news clustered; no p-values for tiny independent shock groups.
futureValidation.usability: Evaluate false warning counts and lead-time distribution for large BTC +20/+50 and -20/-35 actual moves at 1d,7d,13/26/52wk without minimum two-week lag; prioritize risk reduction and miss cost.
futureValidation.risk: No news/market causal conclusion from a single before/after window. Macro shock lists selected after event cannot yield calibrated probabilities. Live news integration requires separate secure approved tool and disclosure.
futureValidation.nextStep: First validate primary timestamp authenticity and independent factor vintages, then code full news vs nonnews corpus and hourly event replay; not a live scheduled watch.

immutableAccounting: No Spot/Futures/NAV/P&L/reserve/capital/MASTER/Detector/trading limit changes and no auto trading.
